scope: Post-v67 logo, shared desktop/mobile cabinet, and desktop three-column / mobile stacked lot details.

method.browser: Installed Google Chrome controlled by Playwright in isolated contexts.
method.server: Loopback static dist preview; local assets served with gzip; hosted API intentionally responds 401.
method.storage: Fresh per-case browser storage. Local draft and photo created by the visible UI, then restored after reload.
method.devices: Desktop 1366x900; iPhone UA/touch at 320x740 and 390x844; Android UA/touch at 320x740, 390x844 and 412x915; simulated native bridge/class for Android 412 and iOS 390.
method.preserved: Existing v67 evidence was not overwritten. No production data, accounts, or remote deployments were modified.

verified: Loaded logo with accessible name and preserved aspect ratio in light header, dark feed and original-photo viewer.
Cabinet sidebar/main layout without horizontal overflow, single draft tab and bottom disclosure, actual text/photo persistence through reload.
Invalid dirty profile cannot navigate away; nested voice settings return retains entered profile fields.
Exact cabinet geometry equality for iOS/Android at 320 and 390; web/native simulation equality for iOS 390 and Android 412.
Desktop lot media/details/offer columns and mobile photo/title/offer/facts order; visible submit control and functioning price stepper without placing a bid.
Actual local original photograph loaded, zoom/reset and nested Back retain lot, visible lot Back closes it.
No page/modal horizontal overflow and no JavaScript exceptions in either completed run.

regression.description: Actual openCar markup with strict DOM insertBefore contract: new layout, new layout without seller links, legacy flat layout, and legacy nested-price layout. Repeated decoration preserves price/form nodes and avoids duplicate controls.
regression.fixedIssue: New nested lot wrappers exposed NotFoundError in buyer-tools/seller-ratings insertion; messages fallback had the same assumption. Production fix uses actual parent and inserts auxiliary controls in facts column.

reproduce.prerequisites: Node.js, available Playwright package and Chrome. Set FAS_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE and FAS_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE if not discoverable; no dependency installation is performed by the runner.

limitations: All mobile cases use Chromium UA/viewport/touch emulation. These results do not establish actual iOS Safari/WebKit, physical device, or installed native package behavior.
Native cases simulate Capacitor/native-app gates; actual Android emulator/APK verification is a separate audit.
Hosted authentication/API, server database, real payments/bids, production service worker upgrade, and deployment were not tested.
Readability checks combine screenshot inspection and dimensions/accessible names; this is not a comprehensive accessibility audit.
readyMs records local navigation-to-ready duration, not a controlled performance comparison or production speed guarantee.

Brand/cabinet and lot were recorded as two bounded runs; the lot run occurred after the decorator bug fix. Raw reports and selected screenshots live in the named external artifact folders, not in the Git repository.

beforeFix.reproduced: Fresh Android: tap Дешевле, then Вся лента. Also saved [low] and [low,ending]. Trusted click reaches handler, feed stays closed with no new feedback.
beforeFix.scope: Reproduced both in current local source and published v67; exact user-device cause not established.

afterFix.method: Isolated Google Chrome, trusted Playwright touch/mouse input; mobile UA/viewport emulation, service workers allowed; real locally served application; no real Android/iOS device.

androidFeedRegression.behavior: Empty selection produces a toast and visible Изменить условия action. Settings open only on a second explicit tap. Opening/closing settings preserves modes, category/search filters, region and recent history. Explicitly toggling Дешевле off allows a nonempty feed to open; no automatic reset or unrelated-lot substitution.
androidFeedRegression.controls: Three Android cases (fresh UI low, saved low, saved low+ending) plus iOS and desktop nonempty controls passed.
androidFeedRegression.command: Set FAS_BROWSER_BASE_URL to an active local preview; node scripts/diagnostics/android-feed-checkup.cjs

featuredShare.method: Isolated Chrome with Android UA/touch emulation; trusted touchscreen taps; real clipboard fallback. OS share boundary is simulated as unsupported at 320 and absent at 390; no external recipient or native share sheet.
featuredShare.behavior: Android 320/390: share control is at least 44x44, below heart with a gap, inside the photo and receives trusted touch. Actual clipboard contains the HTTPS canonical lot URL. Sharing preserves region, recent history, modes, carousel position and the existing lot/feed state.
featuredShare.limitation: Native share-sheet boundary is simulated as unsupported at 320 and absent at 390. Clipboard write/read is real. No external recipient, OS share UI or physical device is exercised.
featuredShare.command: Set FAS_BROWSER_BASE_URL to an active local preview; node scripts/diagnostics/featured-share-checkup.cjs

photoGestures.method: Isolated Chrome with trusted mouse/CDP touch gestures. Android UA/touch emulation, not physical hardware. Real house lot 100200 and its photos; one temporary data-SVG portrait image in the isolated DOM tests object-fit letterbox geometry.

cases.name: android390
checks: Zoomed native pan changes scroll and retains viewer
Portrait object-fit letterbox returns only to lot

cases.name: desktop1366
checks: Photo click, inside-to-outside drag and right click retain viewer; Escape retains lot
Portrait object-fit letterbox returns only to lot

photoGestures.command: Set FAS_BROWSER_BASE_URL to an active local preview; node scripts/diagnostics/photo-gesture-checkup.cjs
photoGestures.limitations: Real house lot and original photos are used for paging, zoom and swipe tests. Portrait orientation uses one temporary data-SVG replacement of the open image only inside the isolated test DOM; no source/data files changed. This does not establish physical-device or WebKit gesture behavior.

vehicleEngineFacts.method: Isolated Google Chrome; iOS/Android UA and touch/viewport emulation. Same real demo car object in every layout; explicit missing/EV/unit fixtures read only through the public helper API. No source data or real device modified.
vehicleEngineFacts.verified: Same actual demo lot1042 across iOS390, Android390, desktop1366 and Android320; explicit legacy 2.0 л unit retained as 2 л, 184 metric hp converted to135.3 kW with labelled conversion. Legacy fuel/power detail rows absent. Missing values remain Не указано; EV volume Не применим; house helper excluded; explicit2.5L/150hp fixture accurate.
vehicleEngineFacts.limitation: Free-form engine description in the catalogue summary is preserved separately by production code. This audit proves absence of duplicate fuel/power detail rows, not removal of all legacy free text. Mobile engines are Chromium UA emulation, not native iOS/Android builds.
vehicleEngineFacts.command: Set FAS_BROWSER_BASE_URL to active local preview; node scripts/diagnostics/vehicle-engine-checkup.cjs
